cards.title: Timing Chain
cards.body: We inspect and replace timing chain components as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Bearings
cards.body: We replace main bearings and connecting rod bearings as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Gaskets & Seals
cards.body: We replace all gaskets and seals as standard during a rebuild.

cards.title: Twin-Scroll Turbocharger
cards.body: The AJ41's twin-scroll turbocharger is a key component that is removed, inspected, and refurbished or replaced as part of the rebuild.

cards.title: Additional Inspected Components
cards.body: Fuel injectors, high-pressure fuel pump, PCV system, timing chain tensioners and guides, and cooling system components are all measured and inspected.

notice: Components drawn directly from VRF Key Components data. If your AJ41's exact ancillary set isn't covered above, we confirm the full scope once your engine is inspected — not guessed in advance.

groups.title: Replaced as Standard
items: Timing chain assembly — chains, guides, and tensioners replaced as standard
Main bearings and connecting rod bearings — replaced during every rebuild
Complete gasket and seal set — full set replaced
Oil filter housing gasket — replaced during rebuild

groups.title: Inspected and Measured
items: Crankshaft — inspected for wear and measured for tolerances
Cylinder head — checked for cracking and warping
Timing chain tensioners and guides — inspected for wear and measured
Oil pump — inspected for wear and pressure tested
Cooling system components — inspected for condition
Fuel injectors — inspected and cleaned where possible
